instruction: Create a plain text signature in Thunderbird with "John Smith" on the first line and "Tech Solutions Inc" on the second line.

metadata.explanation: Variation with different name and company. Task requires setting up email signature through Thunderbird account settings. Uses same evaluator pattern checking prefs.js for mail.identity.id1.htmlSigText with regex match.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric. Signature text verified to match regex escape requirements for special characters (dots, plus signs).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies signature creation by checking Thunderbird prefs.js file for mail.identity.id1.htmlSigText field
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird before reading prefs.js to ensure settings are persisted to disk
Expected value correctly uses escaped newline (\n) to match the two-line signature format
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs uses regex method 're.S' which correctly matches the signature text with newline
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both required lines ('John Smith' and 'Tech Solutions Inc') with proper line separation
State accessibility is sound: prefs.js file persists after Thunderbird closes and can be reliably read
